findings.title: Opposite account movements challenge an isolated spending story
findings.observation: Homelessness Strategies & Solutions FY2023 fund 100000 center 1716000011: account 512059 (Miscellaneous Professional/Technical Ser) is 10563304.00 USD below adopted while account 512066 (Reimbursement Agreements) is 8767029.00 above adopted. 82.9951% of the larger movement is offset by the opposite movement; together these two accounts have adopted 14490978.00 and actual 12694703.00, a net difference of -1796275.00 USD. This is a candidate accounting/service shift, not evidence that money actually transferred or that services were cut.
alternatives: A reclassification, reimbursement agreement, transfer or contract-posting change may explain offsetting movements.
The accounts may purchase different services; one service may have declined while an unrelated service expanded.
Revised appropriations, timing and encumbrances may explain either account separately. Similar amounts do not establish a transfer.
findings.nextTest: Obtain FY2023 fund 100000 center 1716000011 journal entries and budget transfers touching accounts 512059 and 512066, including document/date, offsetting account, vendor/contract/program IDs and revised authority. Reconcile each agreement's invoices and accepted service outputs; reject the reclassification hypothesis if the underlying programs or vendors differ.

findings.title: A spending rebound still leaves an earlier service-funding baseline unexplained
findings.observation: Homelessness Strategies & Solutions fund 100000 actual spending went from 42779044.00 USD in FY2021 to 9815698.00 in FY2022 and 22920122.00 in FY2023. The latest increase of 13104424.00 still leaves recorded spending 19858922.00 (46.422%) below FY2021. A latest-year growth narrative therefore cannot establish restoration of the earlier scope of services; the program/funding boundary needs to be reconciled.
alternatives: One-time grants, emergency programs or capital/startup costs may make the earlier year an inappropriate recurring baseline.
Services or accounts may have moved to another department, fund or administering agency.
A lower amount may reflect efficiency or changed service demand; spending alone does not measure services.
findings.nextTest: Obtain the FY2021–FY2023 program/fund/department crosswalk for Homelessness Strategies & Solutions fund 100000, expiring grant and one-time funding schedules, and comparable service capacities and outputs. Follow any transferred program to its receiving ledger before asserting a cut; separate one-time startup costs from recurring delivery.

findings.title: A larger allocation has not translated into proportional recorded execution
findings.observation: Commission on Police Practices fund 100000: adopted allocation rose 1223218.00 USD from FY2022 to FY2023, while recorded actual spending rose 300402.00. Only 24.5583% of the added allocation is reflected in additional actuals; execution was 37.0264% and 31.0463% of adopted in the two years. The repeated gap merits a capacity and implementation test, not an assertion that the money was available or services failed.
alternatives: Delayed hiring, program launch, procurement or reimbursement can postpone execution.
The organization, accounting scope, fiscal close or funding source may have changed between years.
Revised budgets may legitimately reduce or move authority; adopted funding does not establish spendable balances.
findings.nextTest: For Commission on Police Practices FY2022–FY2023 fund 100000, obtain quarterly authorized/filled/vacant positions, program launch and contract milestones, revised appropriations and transfers, year-end commitments, and accepted outputs. Test whether staffing/procurement timing explains the gap and whether delivery later caught up.

executedEvidence.sql: WITH b0 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(report_fy AS INTEGER) < 100 THEN 2000 + TRY_CAST(report_fy AS INTEGER) ELSE TRY_CAST(report_fy AS INTEGER) END AS fy, CAST(funds_center_number AS VARCHAR) AS center, CAST(account_number AS VARCHAR) AS account_number, dept_name, account, amount FROM "analysis_regional_data_6248b76b917ad88fb00a1800" WHERE CAST(fund_number AS VARCHAR) = '100000' AND CAST(account_number AS VARCHAR) LIKE '5%' AND lower(trim(budget_cycle)) = 'adopted'), a0 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(report_fy AS INTEGER) < 100 THEN 2000 + TRY_CAST(report_fy AS INTEGER) ELSE TRY_CAST(report_fy AS INTEGER) END AS fy, CAST(funds_center_number AS VARCHAR) AS center, CAST(account_number AS VARCHAR) AS account_number, dept_name, account, amount FROM "analysis_regional_data_7ee003c264e5cfe2fe14254e" WHERE CAST(fund_number AS VARCHAR) = '100000' AND CAST(account_number AS VARCHAR) LIKE '5%' ), period AS (SELECT MAX(b0.fy) AS fy FROM (SELECT DISTINCT fy FROM b0) b0 JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fy FROM a0) a0 ON b0.fy=a0.fy WHERE b0.fy <= 2026), b AS (SELECT fy, center, account_number, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT dept_name, ' | ' ORDER BY dept_name) AS departments, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT account, ' | ' ORDER BY account) AS account_labels, SUM(amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) - COUNT(amount) AS missing_amounts FROM b0 WHERE fy = (SELECT fy FROM period) GROUP BY 1,2,3), a AS (SELECT fy, center, account_number, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT dept_name, ' | ' ORDER BY dept_name) AS departments, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT account, ' | ' ORDER BY account) AS account_labels, SUM(amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) - COUNT(amount) AS missing_amounts FROM a0 WHERE fy = (SELECT fy FROM period) GROUP BY 1,2,3) SELECT COALESCE(b.fy,a.fy) AS fiscal_year, COALESCE(b.center,a.center) AS funds_center_number, COALESCE(b.account_number,a.account_number) AS account_number, b.departments AS budget_departments, a.departments AS actual_departments, COALESCE(a.account_labels,b.account_labels) AS account, b.amount AS adopted_budget, a.amount AS actual_spending, b.source_rows AS budget_rows, a.source_rows AS actual_rows, b.missing_amounts AS budget_nulls, a.missing_amounts AS actual_nulls, CASE WHEN b.source_rows IS NULL THEN 'Missing budget baseline' WHEN a.source_rows IS NULL THEN 'Missing actuals' WHEN b.missing_amounts > 0 OR a.missing_amounts > 0 THEN 'Incomplete amounts' ELSE 'Matched' END AS comparison_status, CASE WHEN b.missing_amounts=0 AND a.missing_amounts=0 THEN a.amount-b.amount END AS actual_minus_adopted FROM b FULL OUTER JOIN a ON b.fy=a.fy AND b.center=a.center AND b.account_number=a.account_number WHERE (contains(lower(COALESCE(a.departments,'') || ' ' || COALESCE(b.departments,'')), 'police') OR contains(lower(COALESCE(a.departments,'') || ' ' || COALESCE(b.departments,'')), 'homeless') OR contains(lower(COALESCE(a.departments,'') || ' ' || COALESCE(b.departments,'')), 'park') OR contains(lower(COALESCE(a.departments,'') || ' ' || COALESCE(b.departments,'')), 'librar')) ORDER BY ABS(CASE WHEN b.source_rows IS NULL THEN a.amount WHEN a.source_rows IS NULL THEN b.amount ELSE a.amount-b.amount END) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 24
